doc.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Nelson Harris, Len Sirrah and their apartment
summary: Her husband was Nelson Harris, whose name backwards titles one of her tunes; they shared her apartment and he died in South Carolina.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: . . . thing you’re divulging. But do we get the name of your husband we were talking about.
Yeah. Nelson Harris. Len Sirrah – that’s the name of one of my tunes is his name backwards. It’s a nice tune too. I’m hoping to do that when I go back to New York.
So you guys had – you had an apartment. But you guys had an apartment together though, didn’t you, because you were mentioning something about . . .
I think I had it, and then we got married and he came in on it. Then I left, and he stayed.
Yeah. He was in South Carolina visiting his mom. He died there.
